title: Test gaps: Observer TrailingAad; GroupInfo rebuild with ratchet_tree + external_pub
description: From the mimid-1wgh.4.62 audit: (1) ObserverError::TrailingAad (observer.rs:574-576) has no test; Member path is covered (member_mls_rs.rs:345).
